document.title: fix(core): guard package library state with a mutex
document.summary: `package_library.c` guards the Active Deck App name and path with one `vd_mutex`, and its name and path accessors now copy into caller buffers instead of returning pointers to globals.
document.why: The upload handler thread writes the active name and path while the main thread and the JS thread read them, with no lock in `package_library.c` ([issue #42](source:s1)).

sources.title: Package library active-name globals are shared across three threads without a lock
sources.gist: Upload thread writes g_active_name/g_active_path via publish while main and JS threads read them; guard with a vd_mutex and hand out copies.

sources.title: fix(core): guard package library state with a mutex
sources.gist: Mutex around active state and directory changes; copy-out accessors; host tier passed in Linux Docker.

lookFor: Not done: [issue #42](source:s1) asks for coverage by the package library harness from the test-coverage issue. No harness is added; only the existing CTest and smoke harness ran.

groups.title: Locking inside the package library
groups.why: The active name and path are shared by the upload, main, and JS threads ([issue #42](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `g_mutex` guards `g_active_name`/`g_active_path`, and every public `package_library_*` function reads or writes them only under it, using the new unlocked helpers `read_package_info` and `set_active_locked`.
lookFor: Subtle: `package_library_publish_package` now checks for a missing Active Deck App after the renames, under the lock, not before validating the upload. A Shell set-active that lands during an upload's manifest read now wins over the upload.

Perf: publish holds `g_mutex` across two `rename` calls and the `active-package.txt` write, so the per-frame `package_library_has_active_deck_app` on the main thread waits for them. Deleting the `.replacing` backup and reading manifests stay outside the lock.
`package_library_set_active` and `package_library_remove` hold the lock across the manifest read and `remove_tree`. Both run on the main thread, so only the upload and JS threads can wait on them.
`package_library_remove` now runs `safe_package_name` before comparing with the active name, so a NULL name returns an error instead of crashing in `strcmp`.
The roots stay unlocked `const char *`. They are written only in `package_library_init`, before the JS and upload threads start. `package_library_root()` had no callers and is removed.

groups.title: Call sites copy into stack buffers
groups.why: The accessors no longer return pointers, so each caller needs its own buffer.
groups.summary: `bootstrap.c` and `jslib.c` copy the active path into a `VD_PATH_MAX` buffer before using it.

groups.title: Font and image registries copy the active name
groups.why: Both registries pass the active package name to `package_manifest_read` and need a buffer now.
groups.summary: `fonts.c` and `images.c` get the same two-line change, so read one and skip the other.
lookFor: Subtle: the registries read the active name separately from the path `bootstrap.c` took. These can only disagree when publish sets a first active package between the two reads. In that case the path was empty and both registries return early.

commits.subject: fix(core): guard package library state with a mutex
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The upload thread publishes packages and may set the Active Deck App while
the main thread reads it every frame and the JS thread reads its path. Guard
the active state and installed package directory changes with a vd_mutex and
make the active name/path accessors copy into caller buffers.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
